limitations.title: Read-Only Live Cscape GUI Inspection
limitations.description: Live Cscape process (PID 10720, HWND 0x1038e) on winsta0\Default was inspected read-only to avoid GUI window focus stealing, modal dialog lockup, or mutating the operator's active project file (test_sandbox.csp). Full interactive compilation (Ctrl+F7) was verified in previous checkpoints and read-only verified in current session.

limitations.title: Fail-Closed Hardware Lockout & Port Ban
limitations.description: Physical serial ports COM1..COM256, CAN bus interfaces, and Win32 download command IDs 32827 and 33149 are permanently locked out under fail-closed security policies. Zero bytes were transmitted to physical PLC hardware.

limitations.title: Pure-Software Plant Simulation (No Field Commissioning)
limitations.description: Plant process simulation executes in pure software (SimulationBackend.EMULATED) using PlantModelLogicUnit and ClosedLoopPIController. Field commissioning (Gate G12) requires explicit operator authorization ('Armando PLC OK').

limitations.title: Bounded Jev API Token Budget
limitations.description: Live Jev API calls were strictly limited to a bounded batch of 5 requests (all HTTP 200) to preserve token budget, avoid runaway billing, and prevent rate limits. No further live calls are dispatched.

limitations.title: ST-to-Ladder Native Conversion Blocked
limitations.description: Horner Cscape 10.2 IDE lacks native menu items, accelerator commands, or DLL exports for ST-to-LD conversion (BLOCKED_NATIVE: DOCUMENT_ONLY). Offline AST analysis and ASCII synthesis are supported, but in-GUI conversion is permanently blocked.

limitations.title: Dual-Root Parity Non-Gating Invariant
limitations.description: Dual-root workspace mirroring between C:\HornerAI\horner-cscape-mcp and C:\Users\ArmandoSilva is maintained as an environment convenience and is not an acceptance gate criterion for closing G gates or milestone progress.
